d.title: D+vine Luv
d.jp: D+VINE[LUV][ディヴァイン ラヴ]
d.synopsis: Hyde is a traveling treasure hunter who arrived in Arville with his childhood friend Sakura. Near Arville is a cave, its the largest ruin of the world. Hyde came across a dying man, whom placed a mysterious amulet within Hyde's hands. A week later, the amulet started to glow.
